chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan narrated to me, saying: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to me from Muhammad ibn Isa from Abbas ibn Hilal al-Shami from Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha from his father (peace be upon him) who said:
One who recites [this verse] when he intends to sleep
Indeed, Allah holds the heavens and the earth lest they cease. And if they should cease, no one could hold [them] after Him. Indeed, He is Forbearing and Forgiving.
then his house will not fall [upon him/be damaged].
ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of reciting 'Innallah yumsiku as-samawati wal-ard' before sleeping?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Rida (AS) emphasizes the protective virtue of reciting 'Innallaha yumassikus samaawaati' before sleep, linking the divine attribute of holding the heavens and earth to physical safety. It specifically notes that neglecting this recitation may result in the house collapsing, highlighting a tangible consequence of omitting this dhikr. This practice underscores the Shia tradition of combining theological reflection on Allah's power with practical spiritual safeguards for the home.
